# freecenter_vm_snapshot (Resource)

A snapshot of a virtual machine. Destroying the resource deletes the snapshot (its changes are merged into the disks).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Snapshot name.
- `vm_id` (String) The virtual machine (freecenter_vm id).

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `memory` (Boolean) Include the memory of a running VM, so that reverting resumes it where it was.
- `quiesce` (Boolean) Quiesce the guest file systems (requires the guest tools).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) <host_id>/<vm_id>/<snapshot_id>.
- `snapshot_id` (String) Id of the snapshot on the host.
